entities.summary: Gregory Edward Butler, is an American former professional basketball player who was selected by the New York Knicks in the 2nd round of the 1988 NBA draft. A 6'11" center from Stanford University, Butler played in 3 NBA seasons from 1988 to 1991. He played for the Knicks and Los Angeles Clippers.
